subject: Updated Tobacco Regulations and Youth Substance Assessment
overview: The Board updated local tobacco regulations to align with state law and established a three-day suspension for first-time sales to minors. A regional assessment on youth substance misuse and mental health was also presented.

items.title: Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the December 20, 2022 meeting.

items.title: Tobacco Regulation Updates
items.summary: Approved updated tobacco regulations that incorporate state-level violations and set a three-day business suspension for first-time sales to minors. The Board maintained existing minimum pricing for cigars at $2.50 for singles and $5.00 for multi-packs.

items.title: Youth Substance Misuse Regional Assessment
items.summary: Sophie Greenbaum presented qualitative and quantitative data on youth substance use and mental health across the Mystic Valley Public Health Coalition region. The assessment identified vaping, marijuana, and alcohol as top concerns while noting a need for more proactive prevention education and mental health treatment options.
